title: Hormel Foods Completes Acquisition of Brakebush Brothers, LLC
summary: The post Hormel Foods Completes Acquisition of Brakebush Brothers, LLC appeared first on Hormel Foods .
body_markdown:
Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE: HRL), a Fortune 500 global branded food company, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Brakebush Brothers, LLC, a leading value-added chicken company, for approximately $1.055 billion.


The acquisition meaningfully expands Hormel Foods’ presence in value-added chicken, an important growth area within protein driven by strong demand trends among customers and foodservice operators. With the addition of Brakebush, the company expects its chicken business to approximately triple from a net sales perspective. The acquisition also strengthens the company’s Foodservice business through Brakebush’s category expertise, customer relationships and direct sales organization.


“We’re excited to officially welcome the Brakebush team to Hormel Foods,” said John Ghingo, president and chief executive officer. “Brakebush has built a strong reputation around quality, deep customer relationships and real expertise in value-added chicken. Bringing together two talented teams with a shared focus on delivering for customers strengthens our Foodservice business and supports our long-term growth strategy.”


Founded in 1925 and headquartered in Westfield, Wis., Brakebush is a leading provider of value-added chicken products serving national and regional foodservice operators.


Hormel Foods first announced its agreement to acquire Brakebush on Sept. 30, 2026.


The company expects to provide additional perspective on the acquisition, along with its fiscal 2027 outlook, during its fourth-quarter earnings call on Dec. 3, 2026.
